newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss ad company Publicitas buys Globe Media of Los Angeles.
newsitem.headline: Swiss ad company Publicitas buys Globe Media of Los Angeles.

text.p: Swiss print media advertising group Publicitas Holding AG said Wednesday it bought Los Angeles-based Globe Media Inc., tripling its advertising volume in North America to $57 million.

Publicitas said Globe Media, a privately held company with offices in seven other U.S. cities plus Mexico City, was a promotion and sales agent specialising in attracting national and international advertising for newspapers and periodicals.
It said Globe Media was an agent for publications including the San Francisco Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, the Globe and Mail, Travel & Leisure, Food & Wine, Euromoney, Golf and Sunset.
Globe Media has advertising volume of about $40 million, compared with Publicitas' current $17 million in North America.
"This acquisition significantly strengthens the position of Publicitas in North America," it said.
Globe Media will be integrated into an existing international network of Publicitas promotion and sales agencies, which has 40 companies in 23 countries.
